name: Aryhant WebMCP Browser Tools
description: Browser-side Model Context Protocol tools including in-browser BM25 document search, calculator, live web search, reference URLs, and session PDF export.

tools.name: get_tool_usage_prompt
tools.description: Returns the complete agent operating guide with tool usage rules. Call this first.

tools.name: get_reference_url
tools.description: Returns comma-separated external reference and syllabus URLs configured by the user.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Returns user's local date, weekday, time, timezone, and ISO timestamp.

tools.name: get_chat_history
tools.description: Returns recent dialogue turns prefixed with user: and agent:.

tools.name: chat_post
tools.description: Posts an assistant reply or status message directly into the chat stream.

tools.name: search_document
tools.description: Client-side BM25 search over uploaded document chunks in browser IndexedDB. Returns top 3 relevant pages.

tools.name: clean_document
tools.description: Purges stored document metadata, chunks, and BM25 index from IndexedDB.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Live web search using keyless Tavily AI with automatic DuckDuckGo fallback.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluates decimal and scientific mathematical expressions accurately.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Generates and downloads a publication-quality session PDF report.
